summary: We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented System Engineer (Fresher) to join our Platform & IT Engineering team.
required_skills: Good understanding of Linux/Windows operating systems
Basic knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP)
Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn
nice_to_have_skills: Basic exposure to Docker and cloud concepts
Interest or experience in PXE, OS imaging, Ansible, or system automation
benefits: Accuracy in system installation and configuration tasks
System uptime monitoring and timely reporting of performance issues
Response time to end-user support queries
